messages:
maya: kicked off a small ingest to validate refset indexing for the q4b quant canary — ~5k samples, mostly short-form queries. wanted to surface a few smells early.
liam: nice. did you run dedupe before upload?
maya: yes, local pass using fuzzy shingle + crc32. but i noticed some near-duplicates slipped through (tokenization differences).
anika: fyi the new tokenizer patch changes apostrophe splitting, so hashes miss for ~0.6% of corpus. saw it on the test shard.
sean: that explains the dup strings in the previous run. suggestions: re-tokenize with live tokenizer and rehash, or use embedding-based near-dup cluster.
maya: leaning toward re-tokenize first since we want exact match behavior for refset membership checks. embedding clusters next.
liam: can we get a quick smoke to quantify how many will flip? a script run on the 5k should be fast.
tara: i can run a de-dupe job and produce a small manual review set (1k) for labelers if that helps.
maya: please, that would be great. manual review should prioritize high-traffic intents and ambiguous short prompts.

ingest-bot: refset-upload job 1769456790 started (job id refset-ingest-2026-04-12-01).

anika: quick run results — re-tokenize+re-hash on the 5k: 42 items collapsed that previously looked unique; another ~120 are near-duplicates by levenshtein but different tokens.
liam: numbers make sense. embedding recall check?
anika: ran an embedding-backstop (embed-v1) recall sample: baseline refset vs re-tokenized refset: recall 0.92 -> 0.87 on 500 holdout queries. drop looks correlated with tokenizer changes for contractions.
sean: 0.05 drop is non-trivial. Could be embed model mismatch with tokenization. We should run embed-v2 compare and a quick quant-bench for latency/cost tradeoffs once resolve dedupe.
tara: starting the manual review queue now. labelers assigned: @maya, @liam, @tara (triage), target turnaround 24h.
maya: thanks. also tagging this refset as "canary-refset-2026-04" so we can snapshot and revert easily.

liam: code snippet i used to reproduce dedupe (for anyone who wants to run locally):
```
python scripts/samplebank_query.py --model q4b --limit 5000 --tokenizer live --dedupe-method crc32,shingle
python tools/retokenize_and_rehash.py --input samples.ndjson --tokenizer redwood-v2 --output samples.rehashed.ndjson
```

anika: logs from rehash run:
```
[INFO] loaded 5000 samples
[INFO] applied redwood-v2 tokenizer
[INFO] rehashed 5000 -> 4958 unique (42 collapsed)
[WARN] 120 near-duplicates flagged for manual review
```
ingest-bot: refset-upload job 1769456890 completed (status: partial). inserted 4958 unique items, 120 flagged.

sean: action items summary:
- tara to coordinate manual review on 120 flagged samples (labeler queue id 9873).
- anika to run embed-v2 recall comparison and report numbers.
- maya to snapshot canary-refset and tag ingest runs.
- liam to run quick quant-bench once dedupe is resolved.

tara: will spin up the labeler task and ping reviewers, ETA 6h to get the first 50 reviewed.
liam: if manual review clears, we should re-run the canary with quant profiles q4b-8bit and q4b-6bit to check quality regressions before wider rollout.
maya: agreed. keep the refset in canary mode until we hit <0.02 recall delta and no manual-rejects on high-traffic intents.
anika: i'll post the embed-v2 numbers in this thread once ready. rough ETA 3h.
sean: thanks team. low friction ops here — glad we caught tokenizer drift early. :eyes:
maya: :thumbsup:
